title: Why Bricks Have Holes Through Them 🧱

shots.vo: Every brick has holes. Factories pay extra for them.
shots.prompt: Medium shot, a man centre in a brick factory, grey work shirt, black gloves, holding up one freshly made red clay brick with rows of rectangular holes clearly punched through it, warm industrial light, stacks of red bricks blurred behind, vertical composition, bright warm light, highly detailed

shots.vo: A brick without holes would be heavier, slower to lay, and cost more.
shots.prompt: Medium-wide shot, a weighing scale on a wooden table, on the LEFT pan a thick solid red brick with no holes sitting low, on the RIGHT pan a lighter red brick with visible rectangular holes sitting high, brick pile behind, soft daylight, vertical composition, bright warm light, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name, signs, lettering, writing

shots.vo: But here's the catch: thick solid clay dries and bakes unevenly.
shots.prompt: Medium shot, a large solid red clay brick with a deep jagged crack splitting it in two, resting on a worn kiln floor, open brick kiln behind with orange glow, broken clay pieces nearby, dusty warm light, vertical composition, bright warm light, highly detailed

shots.vo: Holes let heat and steam reach the middle, so the whole brick bakes evenly.
shots.prompt: Medium-wide shot, red bricks with rectangular holes stacked inside a glowing brick kiln, bright orange fire at the base, white steam and hot air rising visibly through the holes, warm orange light, vertical composition, bright warm light, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name, signs, lettering, writing

shots.vo: The air pockets left behind also insulate the wall, keeping rooms warmer or cooler.
shots.prompt: Medium-wide shot, a cutaway brick wall with large hollow air-filled holes clearly visible inside each brick, LEFT side a snowy Indian hill village outside the window, RIGHT side a cosy warm room with a lamp, soft golden light, vertical composition, bright warm light, highly detailed

shots.vo: So the holes through bricks are deliberate: they bake evenly, weigh less, insulate.
